descriptive_rule: first n for which the 10th percentile section correlation with the final eight-day stack is >=0.90 and remains so
decision: The production-fan section is descriptively stable much sooner than the unfiltered section, but this is not physical signal convergence because the same fan fails pre-filter surrogate nulls. The unfiltered 3.2 km/s observable is not independently recovered by the eight-day aggregate.
